items.name: sheenui-theme
items.title: SheenUI theme
items.description: SheenUI base layer: light and dark tokens, glass levels, the Liquid Glass and Aurora Neon style presets, motion tokens and CSS, the cn() helper and the theme, motion and transparency hooks. Every SheenUI item depends on it.
items.author: lokendra-builds <https://github.com/lokendra-builds>
items.docs:
SheenUI base layer, installed in components/sheenui/{lib,motion,hooks,styles}. Docs: https://lokendra-builds.github.io/sheenui/foundations

Requires React 19.2 or newer (the components use useEffectEvent; the CLI does not install react) and Tailwind CSS v4.

1. Check your global CSS (components.json "tailwind.css"): the CLI added `@import "@/components/sheenui/styles/index.css";`. It must come AFTER `@import "tailwindcss";`. Vite resolves the "@/" alias in CSS. Next.js does not (Tailwind's PostCSS plugin ignores tsconfig paths, and `next build` fails with "Can't resolve '@/components/sheenui/styles/index.css'"): there, change it to the relative path from your global CSS, e.g. `@import "../components/sheenui/styles/index.css";` in app/globals.css or src/app/globals.css.
2. Optional but recommended: wrap your app in <SheenMotionProvider> (components/sheenui/motion/provider) and inline sheenPreferenceScript (components/sheenui/hooks/use-preferences) in <head> to apply the saved theme and style preset before first paint.
3. Fonts: Liquid Glass uses Inter Variable (Aurora Neon uses Geist). Install `@fontsource-variable/inter` and import it, or SheenUI falls back to the system font.
4. SheenUI switches dark mode with <html data-theme="dark"> and redefines Tailwind's dark: variant to follow it. In an app that also uses shadcn/ui's .dark class, set both attributes or keep one convention.
